sources.entry: apple-mail-mcp - Fast access to Apple Mail from the command line and AI clients (MCP). Sub-millisecond full-text search using Mail's own SQLite index, verified sends, reviewed bulk triage.

summary.one_liner: A local MCP server that lets AI clients search, read, triage, and send email through Apple Mail on macOS, using Mail's own SQLite index for fast full-text search.
summary.what_it_does: The server runs locally on a Mac and opens the Mail store read-only, returning only what a client requests. It provides 21 tools in groups: read (search_emails with full-body search, get_email, get_thread, list_mailboxes, get_attachment, refresh_mail), send (send_email, reply_email, create_draft, schedule_email, list_scheduled, cancel_scheduled), triage (triage_plan, triage_plan_delete, triage_apply, mailbox_create, mailbox_delete), and meta (doctor diagnostics and an audit ledger). Triage works as a reviewed plan: nothing moves until approved, messages are re-checked before being touched, and results are verified against Mail's records. Identity selection is done through a ~/.email-mcp/identities.toml file that maps From addresses to send lanes (SSH sendmail or SMTP). Exchange accounts can have scheduled sends executed server-side and drafts filed in the real Drafts folder. The README reports benchmarks on a 300k-message store, with the method documented in docs/benchmarks.md.
use_cases: search old email by body text in Apple Mail
let an AI assistant read and summarize mailbox threads
bulk-file or delete newsletters with a reviewed plan
send or reply to email from Claude or Cursor
schedule delayed email that sends from Exchange
create drafts in Outlook-compatible Drafts folder
how_to_run: claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user apple-mail -- uvx apple-mailbox-mcp
Codex CLI: add [mcp_servers.apple-mail] with command = "uvx" and args = ["apple-mailbox-mcp"] to ~/.codex/config.toml
Run doctor to diagnose send lane problems
Grant Full Disk Access and Automation → Mail permissions when macOS prompts
notable: Full-body search via Mail's own SQLite index, with p95 under 1 ms on a 300k-message store per the README
Exchange accounts can fetch message bodies Mail never downloaded, from the server
Scheduled sends are frozen in full and can run server-side via Exchange even with the Mac asleep
Triage uses a plan-approve-apply workflow and deletes go to Mail's Trash
Identity-based send lanes chosen by the From address
caveats: macOS only; requires Apple Mail and Full Disk Access / Automation permissions
Non-Exchange scheduled sends rely on a local background sender and only deliver on its next pass or after wake
First body-index build on a 100k+ mailbox can take minutes
